strategicObjectives: Membangun Ethereum L2 yang mendiferensiasi diri melalui native yield otomatis
Memanfaatkan basis pengguna dan likuiditas Blur untuk bootstrap ekosistem
Menciptakan flywheel insentif via Points (user) dan Gold (builder) untuk menarik TVL dan aktivitas
Menjaga kendali teknis dan governance melalui Foundation terpusat di tahap awal
decisionPatterns: Pragmatic centralized launch → incremental decentralization signaling tanpa timeline konkret
Token incentives sebagai primary growth lever, bukan product differentiation saja
Opacity pada critical financial/token parameters (vesting, treasury, yield retention, audit reports)
Leverage Blur relationship untuk bootstrap, tapi maintain separate entity
Foundation unilateral decision-making pada protocol upgrades
Third-party dependency untuk non-core infrastructure (bridges, messaging, RPC, indexing)
Narrative-driven development (native yield → Points → Gold → governance → staking → fee payment)
No public incident response / post-mortem culture (no exploits/incidents reported)
Blur integration sebagai bootstrap catalyst, bukan long-term dependency
Core DeFi trio (Thruster, Ring, Wasabi) sebagai anchor protocols day-1 mainnet
Third-party bridges (LayerZero, Wormhole, Hyperlane, Orbiter) untuk generic messaging
Kaito partnership untuk InfoFi/social analytics narrative expansion
CEX listings priority: Binance, Bybit, OKX, Gate.io (no Coinbase/Kraken at TGE)
Developer tooling: Foundry-first, Hardhat support, custom SDK
Gold program sebagai primary business development tool
Foundation-first, DAO-second approach
Token-weighted voting (1 BLAST = 1 vote) dengan delegation
No council, committee, atau security board formal structure (per cutoff)
Proposal threshold, quorum, timelock tidak dipublikasikan
v1.1 upgrade dieksekusi Foundation tanpa governance vote (Nov 2024)
Geographic restrictions pada TGE claim (US persons excluded)
Memilih OP Stack fault proof components tapi custom execution/sequencer/yield layer
Centralized sequencer sebagai pragmatic choice untuk time-to-market
Permissioned proposer/challenger sebagai interim security model
Native yield via precompile rebasing bukan ERC-4626 vault
EIP-4844 blob adoption rolling post-Dencun (Mar 2024 onward)
Execution client (blast-geth) tidak open source
No native account abstraction (ERC-4337 via EntryPoint only)
Strategic funding round dari Paradigm + Standard Crypto tanpa public disclosure detail (Nov 2023)
Treasury opacity: no public dashboard, addresses, atau composition (2023-present)
Revenue model: sequencer priority fees + potential native yield retention (undisclosed rate)
Token incentives sebagai primary growth capital (Points 25.5% + Gold 28% = 53.5% supply)
No buyback, burn, atau fee switch mechanism di tokenomics (TGE Jun 2024)
Vesting schedules undisclosed untuk 74.5% non-community allocation
Gold program sebagai ongoing emission mechanism (28% supply over multi-year)
riskResponse: Single sequencer centralization risk → No public mitigation roadmap
Permissioned proposer/challenger → No permissionless challenge game timeline
L1 yield source concentration (Lido + MakerDAO) → No diversification announced
Oracle dependency (Chainlink) → No fallback oracle atau TWAP on-chain
Upgrade key centralization (Foundation multisig) → No timelock, no on-chain governance execution
Bridge 7-day withdrawal delay → No fast withdrawal mechanism native
Execution client closed source → No independent verification possible
Regulatory risk (Cayman + US persons) → Geographic restrictions only, no legal opinion public
TVL decline post-Points Season 1 ($1.48B → ~$400M) → Gold program continuation
tradeOffs: Native Yield Differentiation vs Protocol Dependency Concentration
Token Incentive Growth vs Sustainable Tokenomics
Foundation Control vs DAO Governance Credibility
EVM Equivalence vs Custom Innovation (Native Yield Precompile)
Closed Source Execution Client vs Open Source Ethos
